title: 第21章 不报此仇誓不为人第22章 回老家
lines: 前半年与师爷说得无异，后面形势急转直下。
天下本就被占了大半，朝廷兵马已经从开始主动出击变为守险拒敌。
这么长时间了，皇帝也终于幡然醒悟明白自己的愚蠢。
他派七位先天大高手出去，一出手就是雷霆之势接连打乱三位天王势力。
这一下，十二位天王仅剩七位，剩下那七位也是战战兢兢。
尽管他们身边也有高手，可是哪里防得住七位先天绝顶联手刺杀。
不出意外就要出意外了。
七位高手的下一个目标就是闯王，势力最大的这位。
既然势力最大，那么同样手底下高手也多。
七位高手前去刺杀，结果中计了。
他们被一帮武林人士拖住，随后十万大军围杀他们。
跑不掉，根本跑不掉，一眼望去全是人，在地上打不退人，飞起来还会被弓箭和弓弩袭击，只会更快消耗内力。
倘若他们之中有外功高手还好说，直接硬扛都不怕。
可惜了，外功并不被主流武林人士认可。
七大高手没能召集神龙，直接被割下了脑袋。
收到消息，皇帝又惊又怒。
就像一个赌输的赌徒，这次他彻底疯狂了。
调集百万大军，十位先天高手压阵，势必要一举除掉闯王这位最大的叛贼。
不出意外还是出意外了，其他天王怎么能看着他毕其功于一役呢，当然是纷纷出手使绊子。
兵败如山倒，秦国安也是在这场战役中遭难的。
百万大军出去，逃回来的不到十万人。
皇帝震怒，于是开始大肆抓捕此次战争中失利的将领。
秦国安原本没有过错，甚至还有功劳。
但就因为他抓住时机，但却因没听上司命令就被嫉妒的同僚告了一状。
他就是派人快马加鞭也没别人递折子的速度快。
先入为主，虽然也认可他的一些功劳，但皇帝还是给他治罪了。
全家流放！
然而搞笑的来了，已经没地方流放他们了，因为流放之地都被叛贼给抢掉。
赵国十三州，如今朝廷只剩下半州，而且还是龟缩不动依靠险关才勉强支撑住。
由此可见，朝廷也是秋后蚂蚱蹦跶不了几下。
这下子，剩下那些天王通通开始打起对方的主意。
content_en:
The first half of the year was no different from what the master said, but later the situation took a turn for the worse.
Most of the world has been occupied, and the imperial troops have changed from taking the initiative to defending against the enemy.
After such a long time, the emperor finally realized his stupidity.
He sent seven innate masters out, and as soon as they took action, they used the power of thunder to disrupt the forces of the three heavenly kings one after another.
At this time, only seven of the twelve heavenly kings were left, and the remaining seven were also trembling with fear.
Although there are masters around them, they can't prevent seven innate geniuses from joining forces to assassinate them.
If nothing else, there will be an accident.
The next target of the seven masters is King Chuang, the most powerful one.
Since he has the greatest power, he also has many masters under his command.
Seven masters went to assassinate him, but fell into the trap.
They were held back by a group of martial artists, and then a hundred thousand troops surrounded and killed them.
You can't run away, you can't run away at all, everything you see is full of people, you can't fight them off on the ground, and you will be attacked by bows and arrows and crossbows when flying, which will only consume your internal energy faster.
If there were any masters of external skills among them, it would be easy to say that they wouldn't be afraid if they could just bear it head-on.
Unfortunately, external martial arts is not recognized by mainstream martial arts people.
The seven masters failed to summon the dragon and had their heads cut off.
Upon receiving the news, the emperor was shocked and angry.
Like a losing gambler, this time he went completely crazy.
After mobilizing an army of one million and ten innate masters, they will definitely get rid of King Chuang, the biggest traitor, in one fell swoop.
If there was no accident, there would be an accident. How could the other kings watch him accomplish his feats in one battle? Of course, they all took action to stumble him.
The army was defeated like a mountain, and Qin Guoan also suffered in this battle.
Millions of troops went out, but less than 100,000 people escaped.
The emperor was furious and began to arrest the generals who had failed in the war.
Qin Guoan originally had no fault and even had merit.
But just because he seized the opportunity, he was sued by his jealous colleagues for not obeying the orders of his superiors.
Even if he sends people to work hard, he can't do it as fast as others can.
Although he recognized some of his merits, the emperor still punished him.
The whole family is exiled!
But here's the funny thing, there is no place to exile them, because all the places of exile have been taken away by the rebels.
Of the thirteen states in the Zhao Kingdom, the imperial court now only has half of them left, and it is still standing still and relying on dangerous passes to barely support itself.
It can be seen from this that the imperial court was also unable to jump like a grasshopper after autumn.
At this time, the remaining kings all started to have ideas about each other.
title_en: Chapter 21 I will not be a human unless I take revenge. Chapter 22 Return to my hometown.
